title: More than ten feet.
officialText:
The end of a platform more than 10 feet (3048 mm) in length shall not extend over the
centerline of its support more than 18 inches (457 mm) unless the platform and its tiedown are designed by a qualified
person or the platform has guardrails to prevent access to the cantilevered end.
